title: Charlie Duke vs Bart Sibrel debate on Danny Jones

tellings.quote: Danny just po uh hosted the number one uh moonlanding uh debunker Bart Cyrell, who you have have an amazing episode with, >> and the one of the last living Apollo astronauts, Charlie Duke, who's 90 years old, and they went at it.

plain: In 2025 a podcaster named Danny Jones put two men face to face: Bart Sibrel, whom Michels calls the leading debunker of the moon landings, and Charlie Duke, one of the last living Apollo astronauts, then 90 years old, and "they went at it." Michels tells this to Joe Rogan, who he notes had done an episode with Sibrel himself. It sets a man who says he walked on the Moon against a man who says nobody did.
